title: Graphic Design for Print and Screen

questions.q: In "Read a brief and know the audience Analyse", which of these is a key idea?
o: Align edges so that the eye finds clear lines.
Write the goal, audience, message, size and deadline of the job in five lines.
Test contrast, sizes and alignment and record the results in a checklist.

questions.q: In "Typography Apply", which of these is a key idea?

questions.q: In "Colour and contrast Evaluate", which of these is a key idea?
o: Agree what is in scope and how many rounds of changes are included.

Name files by project, size and version and keep an editable master.
